description: This file defines the SwiftUI view VoiceWakeWordsSettingsView, which provides a user interface for managing wake word trigger phrases for a voice activation feature. It incorporates UI elements for listing, adding, removing, and resetting trigger words, as well as synchronizing these with application preferences and the global state.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Adds an empty string to the list of trigger words.

methods.name: removeWords
methods.description: Removes trigger words at specified offsets and resets to default if the list becomes empty.

methods.name: binding
methods.description: Provides a binding to a specific trigger word at a given index for UI editing.

methods.name: commitTriggerWords
methods.description: Saves the current trigger words to preferences, sanitizes them, and updates the global wake words with a slight delay.
